translation: It also says: water is numbered one, the root of the myriad things, the foremost of the Five Phases; hence kidney water is the root of humans and the origin of life, and it must not be allowed to weaken. If the root and foundation are not firm, then the branches and leaves are not luxuriant; if the primordial qi is not secure, then the body is not flourishing. In the disease of wasting-thirst, the kidney water of the lower part is extremely cold; if one further administers cold medicines, then the primordial qi turns more vacuous and the kidney water of the lower part turns more weakened, then the heart fire of the upper burner becomes hyperactive, and it is difficult to treat.
translator_notes: 不可使之衰弱 (must not be allowed to weaken) preserves the prohibition.
